newsitem.title: GERMANY: BASF to sell tape unit to South Korea's KOHAP.
newsitem.headline: BASF to sell tape unit to South Korea's KOHAP.

text.p: German chemical firm BASF AG, in a surprise move, said Tuesday that South Korean textile group Kohap Ltd. would take over its worldwide magnetic tape unit instead of Turkey's RAKS Holding AS.
BASF said in a statement that Kohap would take control of its Magnetics arm from Jan. 1 for an undisclosed amount. The statement made no mention of a previous letter of understanding with RAKS.

Although a deal with RAKS seemed sealed after it was announced in August, BASF's supervisory board in September demanded that other potential buyers be considered for one of the world's best known tape brands.

The chemical giant's supervisory board had expressed concern that the Turkish group was too small and questioned its ability to run Magnetics, which posted sales of 1.5 billion German marks ($991 million) last year and employs 3,700 workers.
